## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek little man. Among the people of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), he is commonly known as "[Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) Lynde's husband."

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)_

## History

Thomas Lynde is the husband of Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), residing near [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). He remained at home while his wife attended a political rally in town with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Around that same period, his wife noted [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's declining health during a visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I.
